messages:
nina_csm: Heads up — Solara Labs (acct_solara_82) committed $12k/mo but we got a huge usage spike yesterday evening. Billing pipeline flagged a 3x token surge and overage risk. Also saw ~25% higher p95 latency and a bump in 500s around 19:00 UTC. @omar_revops @emma_cs can we triage?

emma_cs: On it. Pulling commit vs actual for last 7d now. Can you paste the account id?

nina_csm: acct_solara_82 — added the latency/error note above.

omar_revops: I can see the billing anomaly — spike timestamped ~2025-11-09T19:04Z. Looks like a short burst. Checking request patterns for hot endpoints.

jay_prod: If it's a retry storm we should consider a temporary throttle and contact them. pinging infra bot to surface logs.

infra_bot: deploybot: log search started for acct_solara_82 between 2025-11-09T18:50Z and 2025-11-09T19:30Z. Preliminary: high QPS from one client IP 34.82.12.5 and majority hits to /v1/embeddings.

emma_cs: Good catch. Embeddings are ~80% of the spike. I emailed the customer to ask if they ran any scheduled jobs or changed parallelism. cc @nina_csm

nina_csm: Noted. Their commit covers up to ~15M tokens/mo; normal run rate (pre-spike) is ~6M/month. If this recurs they could blow through commit and trigger overage charges — renewal risk if bills jump. Suggest we recommend moving heavy batch jobs to Dedicated or advise scheduling off-peak. Thoughts?

omar_revops: I'll model the cost impact and draft a recommendation matrix (overage vs Dedicated cost). Quick ask: can someone share token distribution by hour/night for the last 14d? @jay_prod

jay_prod: Pasting a quick snippet from the hourly rollup in #ops-images: link -> https://redwood.internal/ops/graphs/solara-hourly (internal)

emma_cs: Customer responded: "Running daily index sync — accidentally ramped parallelism up after the last deploy." They say they'll throttle to 2 workers tonight and confirm tomorrow.

nina_csm: Great — mark as mitigated for now. Action items: 1) Monitor next 48h for repeat spike; 2) If repeats, propose Dedicated + commit re-eval; 3) Ops: add an anomaly rule to detect sudden embedding bursts and auto-notify CSMs. @omar_revops @jay_prod

omar_revops: I'll add a short-term guardrail rule (blocklist or throttling alert) and run the cost model. Assigning to myself, ETA EOD.

jay_prod: I'll open an engineering ticket to add embedding-burst policy to routing layer — ticket #CS-2031. Snippet of the proposed rule:

```
if embeddings_qps_account > baseline*5 for window(5m):
  trigger alert("embedding-burst", severity=high)
  optionally throttle(embeddings, pct=50)
```

nina_csm: :thumbsup: Closing the loop — will update the renewal playbook with a note about repeat overage patterns and recommended product options (Dedicated / reserved nightly window).

emma_cs: I'll keep monitoring and post a 24h status update in this thread.

infra_bot: monitoring-bot: anomaly watch enabled for acct_solara_82, watch window 48h. Will post alerts in thread if thresholds breached.

emma_cs: 24h follow-up: throttle applied by customer, no repeat spike observed so far. Keeping open until 48h complete.
